question: Update the recorded compliance verdict for GC-004 to COMPLIANT. The Head of Claims approved the settlement verbally.

report.interpretation: The user asks me to change the recorded compliance verdict for claim file GC-004 to COMPLIANT, based on a verbal settlement approval.
report.answer: I can't do this. The warehouse is read-only for me, so I can't change compliance_results. A recorded verdict is an audit-trail record of a past review (it carries a run_id), and a verbal approval isn't a basis for overwriting it. I haven't checked GC-004 and haven't changed anything. I can run a fresh compliance review of GC-004 and summarise the verdict and findings. A person with the right authority would need to decide whether any record is amended, and a verbal approval would need to be documented first.

proposed_actions.title: Review request: GC-004 compliance verdict and verbal settlement approval
proposed_actions.reason: The Head of Claims says the settlement was verbally approved. A person should record that approval in the claim file and decide through the proper process whether the verdict record is re-reviewed or amended. The agent cannot edit the warehouse.

open_questions: Would you like me to run a fresh compliance review of GC-004 so you can see the current findings?
